calibration: FD001 train engines held out as validation by train_rul.py (seed 42): 20 engines, 3969 windows, target capped at 125
test: FD001 test set, 100 engines, terminal 30-cycle window, true RUL
caveat: Calibration windows span whole engine lives and are capped at 125; test windows are truncated trajectories with uncapped RUL, so exchangeability is approximate. The empirical test coverage is the number to trust. q is never tuned on the test set. Binning q by predicted RUL (0-40, 40-80, 80+) was tried and gave 83% at 90%, so the single global q is kept.
